```{r setup}
# Load packages ----------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DT)
  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(kableExtra)

  library(TCGAbiolinks)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(maftools)
})

params <- list(
  "seed" =  12435,
  "workers" =  4,
  "interactive" =  TRUE,
  "rds_dir" =  "../results/rds/",
  "table_dir" =  "../results/tables/",
  "data_dir" =  "../data/",
  "fig_dir" =  "../results/figures/"
)

# Load globals -----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(params$seed)

if(!dir.exists(params$rds_dir)) dir.create(params$rds_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(params$fig_dir)) dir.create(params$fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(params$table_dir)) dir.create(params$table_dir, recursive = TRUE)

shiny_path <- file.path(
  params$rds_dir, "shiny", "rds"
)
```

# Gene expression data

```{r}
## ----------------------------------------------------------------------
query_rna <- GDCquery(
  project       = "TCGA-LAML",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type     = "Gene Expression Quantification"
)
output_query_rna <- getResults(query_rna)

dim(output_query_rna)
```

```{r}
GDCdownload(query_rna, directory = "../data/")
dat_temp <- GDCprepare(query_rna, directory = "../data/", summarizedExperiment = FALSE)
```

```{r}
mtx <- dat_temp[,-c(1:3)]
mtx_names <- gsub("_TCGA.*", "", colnames(mtx))
table(mtx_names)
```

```{r}
rowdat <- dat_temp[,c(1:3)]
rowdat$gene_id <- sub("\\..*$", "", rowdat$gene_id)
mtx <- as.data.frame(mtx[!which(duplicated(rowdat$gene_id)), ])
rowdat <- as.data.frame(rowdat[!which(duplicated(rowdat$gene_id)), ])

mtx_list <- SimpleList(counts             = as.matrix(mtx[,mtx_names == "unstranded"]),
                       unstranded         = as.matrix(mtx[,mtx_names == "unstranded"]),
                       tpm_unstranded     = as.matrix(mtx[,mtx_names == "tpm_unstranded"]),
                       fpkm_unstranded    = as.matrix(mtx[,mtx_names == "fpkm_unstranded"]),
                       fpkm_uq_unstranded = as.matrix(mtx[,mtx_names == "fpkm_uq_unstranded"])
                       )

mtx_list <- lapply(mtx_list, function(x){
  colnames(x) <-  gsub(".*_TCGA-", "", colnames(x))
  colnames(x) <-  paste0("TCGA-", colnames(x))
  x
})

se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays  = mtx_list,
                           rowData = rowdat)
rownames(se) <- rowdat$gene_id
colData(se)$id <- colnames(se)
colData(se)$patient_id <- gsub("-[[:alnum:]]*-[[:alnum:]]*-[0-9]*-[0-9]*$", "", se$id)
```

# Clincial data

```{r}
## ----------------------------------------------------------------------

query_clin <- GDCquery(
  project       = "TCGA-LAML",
  data.category = "Clinical",
  access        = "open",
  data.type     = "Clinical Supplement",
  data.format   = "BCR Biotab"
)
output_query_clin <- getResults(query_clin)
```

```{r}
GDCdownload(query_clin, directory = "../data/")
clin_list   <- GDCprepare(query_clin, directory = "../data/")
```

```{r}
clin_patient <- clin_list$clinical_patient_laml

clin_patient <- clin_patient[-c(1:2), ]
clin_patient <- clin_patient[match(se$patient_id, clin_patient$bcr_patient_barcode), ]

colData(se) <- cbind(colData(se), clin_patient)
```

# Somatic mutation

```{r}
## ----------------------------------------------------------------------

query_maf <- GDCquery(
  project       = "TCGA-LAML",
  data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation",
  access = "open"
)

output_query_maf <- getResults(query_maf)
```

```{r}
GDCdownload(query_maf, directory = "../data/")
maf <- GDCprepare(query_maf, directory = "../data/")
```

```{r}
maf_genes <- c("NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53")
maf_nonsilent <- maf %>% filter(Variant_Classification != "Silent")

mut_status <- lapply(maf_genes, function(g) {
  mutated <- unique(substr(
    maf_nonsilent$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[maf_nonsilent$Hugo_Symbol == g], 1, 12))
  data.frame(patient = mutated, gene = g, mut = 1L)
}) %>% bind_rows()

mut_wide <- mut_status %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = mut, values_fill = 0L)
```

## FLT3-ITD

```{r}
download.file(
  "https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/data/b9196563-a05d-40b8-80dc-640ec712eb06",
  destfile = "../data/LAML_SuppTable01.xlsx", mode = "wb"
)

supp01 <- readxl::read_excel("../data/LAML_SuppTable01.xlsx")
table(supp01$FLT3)
```

```{r}
supp01 <- supp01 %>%
  mutate(
    FLT3_raw = as.character(FLT3),
    FLT3_ITD = case_when(
      grepl("in_frame_ins", FLT3_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 1L,
      is.na(FLT3_raw) | FLT3_raw %in% c("", "56") ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    FLT3_TKD = case_when(
      grepl("^p\\.D8(35|39)", FLT3_raw) ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  )

supp01 <- supp01[-nrow(supp01), ]

table(FLT3_ITD = supp01$FLT3_ITD, FLT3_TKD = supp01$FLT3_TKD)
```

# Combine all modalities

```{r}
supp01 <- supp01 %>%
  mutate(patient = paste0("TCGA-AB-", `TCGA Patient ID`))

mut_flt3 <- mut_wide %>%
  full_join(supp01 %>% select(patient, FLT3_ITD, FLT3_TKD), by = "patient")

cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
cd_joined <- cd %>%
  left_join(mut_flt3, by = c("patient_id" = "patient"))

stopifnot(nrow(cd_joined) == ncol(se))
rownames(cd_joined) <- rownames(colData(se))

mut_cols <- c("NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53", "FLT3_ITD", "FLT3_TKD")

cd_joined <- cd_joined %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(mut_cols), ~ tidyr::replace_na(., 0L)))

colData(se) <- DataFrame(cd_joined)
```

```{r}
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))

diff_cols <- c(
  "blast_count", "promyelocytes_count", "myelocytes_24hr_of_banking",
  "metamyelocytes_24hr_of_banking", "bands_24hr_of_banking",
  "segs_24hr_of_banking", "basophils_count...42", "basophils_count...43",
  "lymphocytes_count", "monocytes_count", "prolymphocytes_24hr_of_banking",
  "promonocytes_24hr_of_banking", "abnormal_lymphocyte_percent"
)

diff_num <- cd %>%
  select(patient_id, all_of(diff_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(diff_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))

diff_num <- diff_num %>%
  mutate(
    diff_sum  = rowSums(across(all_of(diff_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_missing = rowSums(across(all_of(diff_cols), is.na))
  )

diff_num <- diff_num %>%
  mutate(
    blast_pct = case_when(
      n_missing == 0 & diff_sum >= 90 & diff_sum <= 110 ~ as.numeric(blast_count),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

cd <- cd %>%
  left_join(diff_num %>% select(patient_id, blast_pct), by = "patient_id")

stopifnot(nrow(cd) == ncol(se))
rownames(cd) <- rownames(colData(se))
colData(se)$blast_pct <- cd$blast_pct
```

```{r}
saveRDS(se, file = file.path(params$rds_dir, "se_tcga.rds"))
```
